historical_record.description: Completed as the Dimasalang House, a HUD-funded joint venture between the Tenants and Owners Development Corporation and the Filipino fraternal organization Caballero de Dimasalang, which lobbied at the same time to rename the surrounding streets — Bonifacio, Lapu Lapu, Mabini and Rizal — after historic Filipino figures. It carries the Lipi Ni Lapu Lapu mural on its north side.
“Lipi Ni Lapu Lapu”, a seven-storey mural in nine panels on the north wall, was installed in 1984 to the design of Johanna Poethig. It traces the migration of Filipinos to America.
